title: Analytic: transverse dipole on the axis at m = 1, rotating-dipole flux faces and far field (body of revolution, FDFD)
description:
A radial current element I in the axis cell (em_fdfd_bor, azimuthal order m = 1, point_source component r) in vacuum, cpml on r_hi and both z faces, stationary solve at lambda0 = 1 um on the (r, z) half plane (25 nm cells, ~4.3e4 cells, host SuperLU). At m = 1 the current J_r ~ exp(-j phi) through the ring cross-section of the axis cell (split on its r = 0 and r = dx edges) is, seen from afar, the circularly polarised transverse dipole M (x - j y) with M = I dx / 2: the m = +1 half of an x-directed dipole of moment I dx (an x dipole = the m = +1 and m = -1 orders, each carrying half its power).
Analytic: U(theta) = eta0 k^2 M^2 (1 + cos^2 theta) / (32 pi^2) (theta from the axis; per steradian, phi independent), total P = eta0 k^2 M^2 / (6 pi); the time-averaged radial Poynting flux of a rotating dipole is U / R^2 at every distance (the quadrature cross term has no radial part), so the power through a surface is the solid-angle integral of U: top disc of a box of half height h and radius R (c = h / sqrt(h^2 + R^2)) P_top = 2 pi U_eq ((1 - c) + (1 - c^3)/3), side cylinder P_side = 2 pi U_eq (2 c + 2 c^3 / 3), bottom disc -P_top (flux_monitor is positive toward +z / +r), U_eq = U(theta = pi/2).
Derived values tab: P_top, P_bottom, P_side (flux monitors, 2 pi ring weights) vs their references; U_equator / U_equator_back (far_field at angle 0 / pi) vs U_eq, U_axis_up / U_axis_down (angle pi/2 / 3 pi/2) vs 2 U_eq; pattern_equator = power_norm at angle 0 vs 1/2 (independent of the source normalisation).
Far field tab: em.far vs the dashed (1 + sin^2(angle)) / 2 pattern (angle from +r toward +z in the drawing plane, cos theta = sin(angle); peak-normalised): the m = 1 pattern peaks on the axis, unlike the sin^2 of the m = 0 axial dipole.
Field tab: |E|^2 and |E_r| of the solve (E_r, H_phi non-zero on the axis at m = 1).
Expected agreement: ~1-3 % (the source ring of radius dx, numerical dispersion at 40 cells per wavelength, the PML reflection); the pattern ~1 %. Pins the |m| = 1 axis rule of the BOR operator (no axis E_r unknown; the axis-edge half of the 'r' element becomes the regular phi current of cell 0): an axis E_r with the ring volume r0^2/2 broke the discrete Gauss law of cell 0 and this source then radiated 8/9 of P_total at every dx.

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (40 cells per wavelength)

parameters.name: I_src
parameters.description: element current [A] (through the ring cross-section of the axis cell)

parameters.name: L_r
parameters.description: radial extent of the half plane (cpml beyond)

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: source r: the axis cell centre

parameters.name: h_face
parameters.description: distance of the top / bottom flux faces from the source

parameters.name: R_face
parameters.description: radius of the side flux face (a cell edge)

parameters.name: M_rot
parameters.description: moment amplitude M of the rotating dipole M (x - j y) [A m]

parameters.name: U_eq
parameters.description: power per steradian in the equatorial plane [W/sr] (twice that on the axis)

parameters.name: c_top
parameters.description: cos of the polar angle of the box corner

parameters.name: P_side_ref
parameters.description: power through the side cylinder [W] (P_side + 2 P_top = P_total)
